verdicts.reason: IEA estimates data centres used about 415 TWh, about 1.5% of global electricity, in 2024; with ~15% annual growth the 2025 share is about 1.6-1.7%, within 0.5 pt of 2%.

evidence.title: Energy and AI: Energy demand from AI (IEA)
evidence.shows: Data centres about 415 TWh, about 1.5% of global electricity consumption in 2024; ~945 TWh (~3%) by 2030.

evidence.title: The state of AI (McKinsey)
evidence.shows: Page returned 503 twice; share of organizations experimenting with or scaling AI agents not retrieved.

verdicts.reading: In 2025 deepfake detection will develop like cybersecurity (attackers evading detectors) and industries will collaborate to verify the provenance of some online content.

evidence.title: Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity (C2PA)
